Holstebro is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Atrial Fibrillation Database in Denmark, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1] [^src2]. The report assesses clinical quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation, providing detailed breakdowns at the municipal level to support local quality development and benchmarking across the decentralized Danish healthcare system [^src1] [^src2].

Regarding Indicator 4b, which measures compliance with safety practices for Direct Oral Anticoagulant (DOAC) medications, Holstebro successfully fulfilled the national standard [^src1]. The municipality achieved a compliance rate of 95.0% (902 out of 949 patients), precisely meeting the national threshold of ≥95% and earning a "Yes" designation [^src1]. The 95% confidence interval for this performance was between 93.5% and 96.3% [^src1].

Holstebro was also evaluated under Indicators 1 and 5, which track the early initiation of anticoagulation treatment and the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation, respectively [^src2]. In these categories, the municipality recorded a rate of 0.4% (5 out of 1,329) and 1.1% (14 out of 1,302), with both metrics marked as "Yes" in the report's data tables [^src2].
